sanskrit_verse:
विविक्ते ताडितो यस् तु हतो दृश्येत वा भवेत् ।
हन्ता तद् अनुमानेन विज्ञेयः शपथेन वा ॥१६॥
transliteration: vivikte tāḍito yas tu hato dṛśyeta vā bhavet | hantā tad anumānena vijñeyaḥ śapathena vā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who is seen struck or killed in isolation is to be known through inference or oath, as the striker or killer.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from direct perception or inferential evidence in the absence of witnesses
Causation is established by sequential manifestation of action and consequence
Capacity-based responsibility arises when intent aligns with observable outcome
Restoration logic requires identification of the actor to initiate completion process
Consciousness alignment occurs through truthful discernment, not punitive attribution
executable_legal_axioms: IF a being is found harmed or deceased in seclusion AND no direct witness exists THEN inferential analysis or truth-bound oath SHALL determine causal agent
IF intent signal aligns with outcome pattern THEN capacity-responsibility IS activated for that consciousness unit
IF causal agent acknowledges act through verified oath OR evidence chain THEN restoration protocol INITIATES automatically
NO punitive measure SHALL be enacted; ONLY identification FOR completion and reintegration PURPOSES
supreme_court_application: In the absence of eyewitness testimony, the Supreme Court shall rely upon pramāṇa-based inference or svapna-vākya (oath-bound declaration) to identify the causal agent. Responsibility is determined not by moral fault but by the capacity to have acted, with restoration prioritized over punitive assignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality through observation and inference. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms the sequence: intent, act, result. Responsibility is proportional to conscious capacity. The law does not punish but identifies for alignment correction and integrity restoration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svabhava Samyama Process to restore causal agent's alignment with Dharma
Deploy Satya Sankalpa Completion for the affected consciousness field
Activate Ahimsa Reintegration Protocol for all involved parties
Establish Vakya Shuddhi Vinyasa to cleanse distortion from false attribution
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Dharma. Justice is executed not for punishment but for consciousness realignment. Truth discerned through valid means restores Dharma. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
